field.label: From
field.help: Suffix of the queried name to replace. Only names below it are rewritten, so home rewrites printer.home but leaves a query for home alone.

field.label: To
field.help: Replacement domain forwarded to the resolver mapped on the Domain Overrides tab. The part in front is kept, so with From home and To fritz.box a query for printer.home is forwarded as printer.fritz.box.
